message: The other day, I was in the kitchen multitasking—dinner on the stove and my phone buzzing with reminders. Just when I needed to check my smoke alarm status, my phone died! 😅 It was a good reminder that tech can fail us when we least expect it, so I made a note to double-check the alarms the old-fashioned way. It’s a small thing, but having a plan makes me feel a bit more at ease. How do you keep your home ready for surprises?
